description: Design coverage-guided fuzzing campaigns: choose a fuzz target, write a deterministic harness (libFuzzer/cargo-fuzz, Atheris for Python, AFL++), seed and minimize a corpus, add dictionaries and sanitizers, triage and minimize crashes, and run short fuzz regressions in CI. Use when code parses untrusted or complex bytes (file formats, protocols, decompressors, deserializers, regex/URL/JSON/XML handling), or native extensions that must not crash or corrupt memory. Use only on code and systems you own or are authorized to test. Do NOT use for input-space property checks with typed values (property-based-testing), for judging test strength (mutation-testing), or for black-box attacks on live services.
